OXY_AIRHOUSE_OBS_INSECURE.gates: Cameras: accept a self-signed TLS certificate from the Airhouse observation store (`1`/`true`); a local Airhouse only.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_CONNS_PER_IDENTITY.gates: Pooled Airhouse connections kept per identity.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_DISABLED.gates: `1`/`true` bypasses the Airhouse connection pool and opens a connection per query (an escape hatch).

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_IDLE_SECS.gates: How long an idle pooled Airhouse identity is kept before the sweeper closes it.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_MAX_APP_IDENTITIES.gates: Pooled Airhouse identities reserved for custom-app (`app:`) keys.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_MAX_IDENTITIES.gates: Pooled Airhouse identities for workspace keys; the oldest is evicted past it.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_POOL_MAX_PREVIEW_IDENTITIES.gates: Pooled Airhouse identities reserved for preview runs (`preview:` keys), so previews cannot evict production's.

OXY_AIRHOUSE_SNAPSHOT_WINDOW_HOURS.gates: How far back a custom app's Airhouse plane snapshot reaches.

OXY_API_URL.gates: The admin host's public API URL. Derives the org-subdomain zone (`app.<zone>`), the customer-apps zone (`app{-env}.` → `customer-apps{-env}.`), the admin base URL unauthenticated subdomain visitors bounce to, and the links Slack and health alerts build. Migrated to `oxy_app_core::config::HostsConfig`.

OXY_APNS_TOPIC.gates: The APNs topic (bundle id) the iOS simulator push path stamps on a notification.

OXY_APP_ADMINS.gates: Legacy spelling of `OXY_GLOBAL_ADMINS`, still honoured by the custom-apps `auth.rs` staff check alongside the current name. Nothing else reads it.

OXY_APP_CALL_TRACE_RETENTION_DAYS.gates: How many days of custom-app host-call traces the store keeps before pruning.

OXY_APP_EMAIL_FROM.gates: The verified SES sender for a custom app's `ctx.email.send`.

OXY_APP_EMAIL_LOCAL_TEST.gates: `1`/`true` opens a custom app's rendered email in the browser instead of sending it through SES; `0`/`false` forces a real send. A dev box runs cloud mode, so set it there.

OXY_APP_EMAIL_REGION.gates: The AWS region the custom-app SES client sends from.

OXY_APP_ENV_OLTP_BRANCHES_MAX.gates: Cap on the OLTP branches one custom-app environment may hold.

OXY_APP_SANDBOX_IDLE_DAYS.gates: Days a custom-app sandbox may sit unused before maintenance retires it.

OXY_APP_SANDBOX_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL_SEC.gates: How often the sandbox maintenance pass runs.

OXY_APP_SANDBOX_OLTP_SEED_MAX_ROWS.gates: Rows copied per table when a sandbox OLTP schema is seeded from production.

OXY_APP_SANDBOX_OLTP_SEED_MAX_TABLE_BYTE.gates: Bytes copied per table when a sandbox OLTP schema is seeded.

OXY_APP_SANDBOX_OLTP_SEED_MAX_TOTAL_BYTE.gates: Total bytes copied when a sandbox OLTP schema is seeded.

OXY_AUDIT_ANCHOR_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often the singleton writes each org's audit-chain head to the anchor bucket.

OXY_AUDIT_ANCHOR_KEY_PREFIX.gates: Key prefix for audit anchors in the bucket.

OXY_AUDIT_ANCHOR_RETENTION_DAYS.gates: Object Lock retention requested for each audit anchor.

OXY_AUDIT_ANCHOR_S3_BUCKET.gates: The Object-Lock bucket audit-chain heads are anchored in; unset turns the job off.

OXY_AUTH_ALLOW_LOCALHOST_RETURN.gates: Lets a sign-in `return_to` point at localhost, for a local web app against a remote API.

OXY_BIN.gates: Test utils: the `oxy` binary the CLI tests drive, instead of the one cargo built.

OXY_BUNDLE_CACHE_MAX_MB.gates: Resident-byte budget of the custom-app bundle cache; the 8192-entry cap stays either way.

OXY_CAMERAS_AIRHOUSE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SEC.gates: Cameras: connect timeout to the Airhouse observation store.

OXY_CAMERAS_AIRHOUSE_INGEST_TTL_SECS.gates: Cameras: how long an ingest Airhouse connection is reused.

OXY_CAMERAS_AIRHOUSE_INSERT_CHUNK_ROWS.gates: Cameras: rows per Airhouse INSERT chunk.

OXY_CAMERAS_AIRHOUSE_MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEM.gates: Cameras: reconnect attempts to Airhouse before the ingest gives up.

OXY_CAMERAS_AIRHOUSE_READ_TTL_SECS.gates: Cameras: how long a read Airhouse connection is reused.

OXY_CAMERAS_BUFFER_MAX_ROWS.gates: Cameras: rows the ingest buffer holds before it drops the oldest.

OXY_CAMERAS_CLIPS_S3_BUCKET.gates: Cameras: the bucket incident clips are stored in; unset disables clip storage.

OXY_CAMERAS_CLIPS_S3_KEY_PREFIX.gates: Cameras: key prefix for incident clips.

OXY_CAMERAS_CLIPS_S3_PRESIGN_TTL_SECONDS.gates: Cameras: how long a presigned clip URL stays valid.

OXY_CAMERAS_EDGE_HLS_PORT.gates: Cameras: the edge box's HLS port the server proxies.

OXY_CAMERAS_EDGE_PLAYBACK_PORT.gates: Cameras: the edge box's playback port the server proxies.

OXY_CAMERAS_EDGE_PREVIEW_PORT.gates: Cameras: the edge box's snapshot preview port the server proxies.

OXY_CAMERAS_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS.gates: Cameras: how often the ingest buffer flushes to Airhouse.

OXY_CAMERAS_INGEST_BUFFER_DISABLED.gates: Cameras: write each ingest batch straight through instead of buffering.

OXY_CAMERAS_INGEST_MAX_FLUSH_ATTEMPTS.gates: Cameras: failed flushes tolerated before a buffer is dropped.

OXY_CAMERAS_TURN_AUTH_SECRET.gates: Cameras: the shared secret that signs TURN credentials; unset reports WebRTC unavailable.

OXY_CAMERA_HEALTH_DECODER_ERROR_LIMIT.gates: Cameras: decoder errors in the window that mark a camera unhealthy.

OXY_CAMERA_HEALTH_FPS_TARGET.gates: Cameras: frames per second below which a camera is flagged.

OXY_CAMERA_HEALTH_RECONNECT_LIMIT.gates: Cameras: reconnects in the window that mark a camera unhealthy.

OXY_CAMERA_HEALTH_STALE_FRAME_SECS.gates: Cameras: seconds without a frame before a camera is stale.

OXY_CAMERA_HEALTH_STALE_REPORT_SECS.gates: Cameras: seconds without a health report before an edge is stale.

OXY_CAMERA_LOG_RETENTION_INFO_DAYS.gates: Cameras: days of info-level edge logs kept.

OXY_CAMERA_LOG_RETENTION_WARN_DAYS.gates: Cameras: days of warn-and-above edge logs kept.

OXY_CAMERA_LOG_SWEEP_INTERVAL_HOURS.gates: Cameras: how often the log retention sweep runs.

OXY_CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.gates: Product observability store: the ClickHouse database.

OXY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.gates: Product observability store: the ClickHouse password.

OXY_CLICKHOUSE_URL.gates: Product observability store: the ClickHouse HTTP endpoint (`oxy start` sets it for its own container).

OXY_CLICKHOUSE_USER.gates: Product observability store: the ClickHouse user.

OXY_COMPILE_BLOB_S3_BUCKET.gates: The bucket the compile worker mirrors DuckDB files and other blobs into; without it a compiled workspace cannot be served by a diskless replica.

OXY_COMPILE_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often stuck compiles are failed and old revisions pruned.

OXY_COMPILE_RECONCILE.gates: DEPRECATED override for one release: the periodic branch check and the GitHub push webhook that queue a commit compile when a default branch moves. The registry flag `compile_reconcile` decides when it is unset; set, it wins and logs a deprecation warning once. See feature-flags.md, "Rollout gates and their sunset".

OXY_COMPILE_REFUSE_FILE_CREDENTIALS.gates: DEPRECATED override for one release: fail (rather than warn on) a compile whose config reads a key file (`key_path`, Snowflake private-key path) on a cloud role. Only `1` counts. The registry flag decides when it is unset.

OXY_COMPILE_REFUSE_RETIRED_AUTOMATION_ST.gates: DEPRECATED override for one release: fail (rather than warn on) an automation that carries `export:`, `cache:` or `agent_ref: __builder__`. Read in `oxy-compile` only as the fallback for a compile with no `ConfigGate`; the production gate carries the flag.

OXY_COMPILE_RETENTION_DAYS.gates: How long non-current compiled revisions are kept before deletion.

OXY_COMPILE_STUCK_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: A revision `compiling` longer than this is marked failed.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_FETCH_MAX_BYTES.gates: Ceiling on the `fetch.maxResponseBytes` a custom-app function may declare for `ctx.fetch`.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_MAX_APPS_PER_ORG.gates: Custom apps one org may hold.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_MAX_PUBLISHES_PER_HOUR.gates: Publishes one org may make per hour.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_REPO.gates: The GitHub repository the custom-app scaffold writes a new app into.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_S3_BUCKET.gates: Where published custom-app builds are stored; unset keeps them on the local disk, which only a single-process deployment can serve.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_STORAGE_ENVIRONMENT_MA.gates: Soft cap on one app's non-production storage silo (staging, a dev slot).

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_STORAGE_HARD_LIMIT_BYT.gates: Bytes past which an org's `ctx.storage` writes are refused.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET.gates: The `ctx.storage` object store; the local fallback cannot mint presigned URLs.

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_STORAGE_SOFT_LIMIT_BYT.gates: Bytes past which an org's storage is reported over quota (writes continue).

OXY_CUSTOMER_APPS_STORAGE_SWEEP_INTERVAL.gates: How often the storage-quota sweep runs.

OXY_CUSTOM_APPS_ZONE.gates: The DNS zone custom-app subdomains live under. Migrated to `oxy_app_core::config::HostsConfig`.

OXY_CUSTOM_APP_UPDATES.gates: Platform-wide update mode for open custom apps: `auto` reloads a tab onto a new build, `observe` only notes it, `off` wins over an app's own `performance.autoUpdate`.

OXY_CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DOH_URL.gates: Comma-separated DNS-over-HTTPS resolvers used to verify a customer's custom-domain CNAME and TXT records.

OXY_CUSTOM_DOMAIN_SCHEME.gates: The scheme a verified custom domain's hand-off redirect uses (`http` for a local edge).

OXY_CUSTOM_DOMAIN_TARGET.default: unset (no TLS edge; the console says so)
OXY_CUSTOM_DOMAIN_TARGET.gates: The hostname a customer points their custom domain's CNAME at. Migrated to `oxy_app_core::config::HostsConfig`.

OXY_DATABASE_AUTH_MODE.gates: Control-plane Postgres auth: `password` reads `OXY_DATABASE_URL`; `iam` builds the DSN from host/port/name/user/region with an RDS IAM token.

OXY_DATABASE_HOST.gates: Control-plane Postgres host (IAM auth mode); also printed by `oxy worker` when it describes its database.

OXY_DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS.gates: Upper bound of the control-plane Postgres pool.

OXY_DATABASE_MIN_CONNECTIONS.gates: Idle connections the control-plane Postgres pool keeps.

OXY_DATABASE_NAME.gates: Control-plane Postgres database name (IAM auth mode).

OXY_DATABASE_REGION.gates: The AWS region of the control-plane Postgres (IAM auth mode) and of the KMS master key when no explicit region is set.

OXY_DATABASE_SSL_MODE.gates: TLS strictness of the control-plane Postgres connection (`require`, `verify-full`, …), honoured by the pool and the LISTEN connections alike.

OXY_DATABASE_URL.gates: The control-plane Postgres DSN. `oxy start` sets it for its own process; the migration binary, the local OLTP provider and the in-source tests read the same one. `oxy seed-partners` refuses a DSN that does not look local.

OXY_DEBUG.gates: Debug logging for the binary (`oxy-server` logging bootstrap).

OXY_DEV_LOGIN_EMAILS.default: unset → `OXY_GLOBAL_ADMINS` on a debug build, loopback only; nothing on a release build
OXY_DEV_LOGIN_EMAILS.gates: The identities `/dev-login` mints a real session for without OAuth. Never set on a reachable deployment.

OXY_DISABLE_INPROCESS_WORKERS.default: unset → derived from `OXY_ROLE` (a `serve` replica derives off)
OXY_DISABLE_INPROCESS_WORKERS.gates: Explicit override, both directions, of whether `oxy serve` runs its in-process task workers.

OXY_DOCUMENT_AGENT.gates: The agentic agent a document library's ask box runs.

OXY_EDGE_INSTALL_URL.gates: Cameras: the edge install script the operator enrolment page shows.

OXY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.default: unset → a key file under `OXY_STATE_DIR` (single-process only)
OXY_ENCRYPTION_KEY.gates: The secrets-store encryption key. A fleet role (`OXY_ROLE=ide|serve|worker`) refuses to create a key file and needs this or a KMS master key.

OXY_FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.default: unset (FCM push skipped, one startup warning)
OXY_FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.gates: The Firebase service-account key, as one-line JSON, for Android push.

OXY_FEATURE_FLAG_REFRESH_MS.gates: How often each instance re-reads the feature-flag table. Mainly a test knob for a sub-second loop.

OXY_FLEET_CLAIM_SALT.gates: Cameras: the salt in edge claim codes. Must be set in production.

OXY_FUNCTION_HEAP_LIMIT_MB.gates: Per-isolate V8 heap ceiling for Oxy Functions; breaching it kills the isolate, not the process.

OXY_FUNCTION_MAX_ORG_CONCURRENCY.gates: Per-org sub-limit of concurrent function invocations.

OXY_FUNCTION_MAX_QUEUED.gates: Invocations that may wait for a permit at once.

OXY_FUNCTION_QUEUE_BUDGET_SECS.gates: How long an invocation may queue before it is shed.

OXY_GIT_FETCH_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often the Factory fetches each remote-backed workspace's remote.

OXY_GLOBAL_ADMINS.gates: Comma-separated emails bootstrapped as `is_app_admin` at `oxy serve` start and by `oxy seed`; the custom-apps staff check and the debug-build dev-login fallback read it too. Platform standing is still authorised through `oxy-authz`, never from this list.

OXY_HEALTH_FAIL_RATE_DEGRADED.gates: Workspace health: job failure rate that reads Degraded.

OXY_HEALTH_FAIL_RATE_UNHEALTHY.gates: Workspace health: job failure rate that reads Unhealthy.

OXY_HEALTH_MIN_RUNS.gates: Workspace health: runs needed before a failure rate counts.

OXY_HEALTH_REALERT_HOURS.gates: How often a workspace that stays unhealthy is re-alerted to the ops Slack channel.

OXY_HEALTH_WINDOW_HOURS.gates: Workspace health: the window job outcomes are judged over.

OXY_IDE_DEFER_AIRWAY.gates: Set on the `ide` only: decline `airway` runs at selection so the worker fleet drives them; a run unclaimed for 30 s is taken anyway. Superseded by `OXY_IDE_DEFER_QUEUE_WORK`. Candidate for the registry's `Rollout` kind.

OXY_IDE_DEFER_QUEUE_WORK.gates: Set on the `ide` only: drive only `compile` from the Global queue and leave every other kind to the worker fleet. The intended `ide` default once worker sizing is settled. Candidate for the registry's `Rollout` kind.

OXY_IDE_UPSTREAM.gates: The Service URL a `serve` replica reverse-proxies `IdeOnly` routes to. Must select the ide pods only.

OXY_IMAGE_TAG.gates: The image tag this process runs as, set by the image build; reported in build identity and compiler versions.

OXY_INPROC_GLOBAL_WORKER.default: unset → derived from `OXY_ROLE` (only a `serve` replica skips it)
OXY_INPROC_GLOBAL_WORKER.gates: Explicit override, both directions, of whether this process runs the global singleton worker (schedules, monitor scans, pre-aggregation).

OXY_INPROC_GLOBAL_WORKER_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: The global singleton worker's tick interval.

OXY_INTERNAL_ORGS.gates: Comma-separated org UUIDs Oxy operates for itself: their apps may call `ctx.platform.facts()` and their members count as staff there.

OXY_LATENCY_WORKER_INTERVAL_MS.gates: How often the in-process latency worker polls the task queue.

OXY_LOG_FORMAT.gates: `json` forces the one-object-per-line stderr format; `text` forces the human one.

OXY_LOG_LEVEL.gates: What is printed to stderr (RUST_LOG syntax). `OXY_OTEL_FILTER` is what is exported.

OXY_MAX_INFLIGHT_PER_WORKSPACE.gates: Admission control: concurrent requests one workspace may have in flight.

OXY_MAX_INFLIGHT_REQUESTS.gates: Admission control: concurrent requests one replica accepts before shedding.

OXY_METRICS_PORT.gates: Binds `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text) on its own in-cluster listener for serve/ide.

OXY_MIN_EDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION.gates: Cameras: an edge posting a lower protocol version is marked incompatible.

OXY_OAUTH_REDIRECT_ORIGIN.gates: A fixed OAuth redirect origin (a bounce proxy) for Google/GitHub sign-in and the GitHub App flows, so one registered redirect URI serves many hosts.

OXY_OBSERVABILITY_BACKEND.gates: `clickhouse` turns on the product observability store; `oxy start` boots a ClickHouse container for it.

OXY_OBSERVABILITY_LOG_LEVEL.gates: Level of the observability crate's own span capture.

OXY_OLTP_ADMIN_URL.default: unset (`oxy start` points it at its own Postgres)
OXY_OLTP_ADMIN_URL.gates: Per-org OLTP `local` provider: the cluster tenant databases are created on.

OXY_OLTP_BRANCH_HISTORY_HOURS.gates: How long a retired OLTP environment branch is kept for history.

OXY_OLTP_NEON_API_KEY.gates: Per-org OLTP `neon` provider: the Neon API key.

OXY_OLTP_NEON_ORG_ID.gates: Per-org OLTP `neon` provider: the Neon organisation.

OXY_OLTP_PG_VERSION.gates: Postgres major version new OLTP tenants are provisioned with.

OXY_OLTP_PROVIDER.default: unset (no provider; `oxy start` defaults its own process to `local`)
OXY_OLTP_PROVIDER.gates: `local`, `neon` or `mock`: where per-org OLTP tenants are provisioned. A partial config is a startup error.

OXY_OLTP_REGION.gates: Per-org OLTP `neon` provider: the region of new projects.

OXY_OPS_ALLQUIET_FUNCTION_FAILURES_URL.gates: The All Quiet webhook that opens an incident when a custom app's function failures cross the page threshold.

OXY_OPS_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.gates: Workspace-health ops alerts: the Slack bot token. Both Slack vars must be set or nothing is pushed.

OXY_OPS_SLACK_CHANNEL.gates: Workspace-health ops alerts: the Slack channel.

OXY_ORG_SUBDOMAIN_ZONE.default: unset → derived from `OXY_API_URL` when its host's first label is exactly `app`
OXY_ORG_SUBDOMAIN_ZONE.gates: The DNS zone bare org subdomains live under; required on non-prod. Migrated to `oxy_app_core::config::HostsConfig`.

OXY_OTEL_FILTER.gates: What platform telemetry exports over OTLP (RUST_LOG syntax).

OXY_OWNER.gates: Comma-separated emails of the Global Owner(s). Read only by `oxy-server-authz`'s owner guard, the one door for the fact.

OXY_PERIODIC_TICK_BATCH.gates: Periodic driver: how many due workspaces one claim takes per tick on a node; a tick keeps claiming while batches come back full. Raise the fleet, not this, when `oxy_periodic_due_backlog` stays above zero across ticks.

OXY_PREVIEW_COW_MAX_ROWS.gates: A preview's write-in-place copies the live table whole up to this many rows.

OXY_PREVIEW_DIFF_MAX_ROWS.gates: A transform build's compare counts differing rows only when neither side exceeds this.

OXY_PREVIEW_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often the preview schema sweep runs.

OXY_PREVIEW_RUNS.gates: Truthy turns on `/previews/runs` (held procedure dry runs). Enable only once every replica runs the release that carries it. Candidate for the registry's `Rollout` kind.

OXY_PREVIEW_RUN_MAX_MINUTES.gates: A preview run still running after this is retired.

OXY_PREVIEW_SAMPLE_MAX_SECS.gates: An Airway sample of a source with no date window is cut off (partial) after this.

OXY_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_TTL_HOURS.gates: Hours after its last write that a preview's Airhouse schemas are dropped.

OXY_PREVIEW_SQL_CORPUS.gates: A checkout whose SQL the ignored `sql_kind_corpus` test classifies, run by hand. Test-only code included through `#[cfg(test)] #[path]`.

OXY_PUBLIC_URL.gates: Cameras: the Oxy URL baked into the edge install command.

OXY_RECONCILE_PCT_UNHEALTHY.gates: Workspace health reconcile: drift percentage that reads Unhealthy.

OXY_RECONCILE_REPORT_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: Workspace health reconcile: how long an external source report may take.

OXY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: Default per-request timeout of the HTTP timeout middleware (`X-Oxy-Request-Timeout` overrides per request).

OXY_RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS.gates: Comma-separated extra labels that can never be an org subdomain. Migrated to `oxy_app_core::config::HostsConfig`.

OXY_ROLE.gates: This process's fleet role (`ide`, `serve`, `worker`, `all`): what it owns and which routes it serves. Parsed by `oxy_app_core::config` for the role manifest; the binary's telemetry bootstrap, the Postgres pool and the secrets key-file check read the raw value before or below that.

OXY_SEED_ALLOW_REMOTE.gates: Lets `oxy seed-partners` run against a database that does not look local.

OXY_SERVICE_NAME.gates: Service name stamped on product observability spans.

OXY_SERVICE_TOKENS.gates: JSON list of `{name, role, sha256}`: platform credentials configured as code (`oxy_auth::token::service`). A request whose `oxysvc_` token hashes to an entry acts as `service:<name>` with that platform role over every org, minus grant management. Read by `oxy_app_core::config::BootConfig`; a malformed value refuses the boot.

OXY_SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN.gates: The parent domain session cookies (web, frontline kiosk) are scoped to, so one sign-in covers the admin host and org subdomains; also counted as a platform zone a custom domain may not be under.

OXY_SESSION_COOKIE_FORCE_SECURE.default: unset (Secure when the request is HTTPS)
OXY_SESSION_COOKIE_FORCE_SECURE.gates: Force the `Secure` attribute on session cookies behind a TLS-terminating proxy.

OXY_SKIP_MIGRATIONS.gates: `1`/`true` makes `oxy serve` skip migrations because the migrate Job ran them; set on the stateless fleet.

OXY_SMOKE_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: Workspace health smoke: time allowed for one agent probe.

OXY_SMOKE_CONCURRENCY.gates: Workspace health smoke: probes run at once.

OXY_SMOKE_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: Workspace health smoke: time allowed for one SQL probe.

OXY_SMOKE_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: Workspace health smoke: time allowed for a whole pass.

OXY_SOURCE_UPLOAD_ZONE.gates: The `s3://` zone file-source uploads land in; a pipeline's `base_path` must sit under it.

OXY_STAGING_AIRHOUSE_MIGRATION_DEADLINE_.gates: A publish's staging Airhouse migrations stop starting new files after this; never fails the publish.

OXY_STATE_DIR.gates: The single-process state directory: workspaces, the secrets key file, local custom-app builds and storage.

OXY_STDERR_CAPTURE.gates: `off`/`false`/`0` stops rewriting stray stderr lines into JSON in the JSON log format.

OXY_TASK_QUEUE_DEAD_RETENTION_DAYS.gates: How long dead tasks stay in `agentic_task_queue`.

OXY_TASK_QUEUE_RETENTION_DAYS.gates: How long completed tasks stay in `agentic_task_queue`.

OXY_TASK_QUEUE_RETENTION_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often the task-queue retention sweep runs.

OXY_TOAST_BASE_URL.gates: The Toast API the reconcile source calls when the workspace's `reconcile.yml` names no base URL.

OXY_UPDATE_GOLDEN.gates: `1` rewrites the env-policy golden files instead of comparing against them.

OXY_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.gates: Web Push: the VAPID private key (PKCS#8 PEM). All three VAPID vars or none.

OXY_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.gates: Web Push: the VAPID public key (base64url).

OXY_WORKER_HEALTH_PORT.gates: The port `oxy worker` serves its health and `/metrics` endpoints on.

OXY_WORKER_MAX_INFLIGHT.gates: Tasks one worker process runs at once; the worker metrics report the cap.

OXY_WORKER_RECOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often `oxy worker` runs its recovery tick.

OXY_WORKTREE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS.gates: How long an unused branch worktree is kept before the sweep removes it.

OXY_WORKTREE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECS.gates: How often idle branch worktrees are swept.
